verdict.rationale: mParticle documents creating audiences and connecting them to audience outputs for activation, and its marketing site describes a describe-the-audience flow that suggests the segmentation logic, which implies a no-SQL path. The evidence never shows a visual trait/behavior builder or a pre-activation size estimate. missing for 10: documented visual drag-and-drop builder combining traits and behaviors, explicit no-SQL confirmation, estimated audience size before activation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audiences from traits and behavior in a visual builder — no SQL required — and see estimated size before activating

citations.quote: Once you have created an audience, you must connect it to an audience output where you can activate it.
Describe the audience, journey, or growth goal. mParticle understands the customer data behind it, suggests the logic to use, and helps turn intent into revenue-driving activation.
